title: Pixel art, 8-bit era
description: Tiny sprites on small tiles with a very small fixed palette and hard one-pixel edges, like early console games.

art_style.outline_policy: One-pixel dark outline around every sprite; no anti-aliasing.
art_style.shading_policy: Flat colour with two or three tones per material; no gradients.
art_style.texture_policy: Tiny repeating patterns only; no noise.
art_style.pixel_density: One art pixel is one game pixel; tiles 8 to 16 px, characters 8 to 24 px tall.
art_style.palette_reference: A fixed palette of at most 32 colours, chosen once for the whole game.

native_size_guidance: Draw at the final pixel size: tiles of 8 or 16 px and sprites one to three tiles tall. Never draw large and shrink.
avoid: Do not use anti-aliasing, blur or soft gradients.
Do not draw detail finer than one art pixel.
Do not mix pixel sizes: every art pixel is the same size across the whole image.
Do not add colours outside the fixed palette of 32.
Do not use dithering unless the owner asks for it.
